testsuite.name: com.systemwebstudio.wiring.DataSchemaManagementApiTests

testcase.name: a disabled source cannot be discovered, and a discovery that cannot be audited stores nothing()
strict body - an unknown or authority key and a non-boolean includeSamples are refused()
discover stores a snapshot and GET returns it - structure only, no samples unless asked()
another workspace or tenant cannot discover or read it, and cannot tell it exists()
samples are opt-in, masked, and need QUERY_EXECUTE as well as DATA_SOURCE_MANAGE()
a second discovery inside the cooldown is REFRESH_TOO_SOON and stores nothing()
permissions - only DATA_SOURCE_MANAGE may discover or read the stored schema, a stranger gets 404()
